description: Canonical many-to-many mapping from scenarios to catalog SKUs. A scenario can belong to multiple SKUs. This file is the source of truth for scenario-to-bundle/add-on membership. Updated when catalog-strategist proposes membership changes and human curates.

role.headliner: Standalone-appealing, deployable-today. Acquisition hook for the SKU.
role.depth: Depth-layer — amplifies a headliner or is a future headliner still gated on prereqs.
role.amplifier: Depth-layer variant that specifically amplifies an existing headliner.
role.future-headliner: Depth-layer variant expected to become a headliner when prereqs land.
role.shared-utility: Reused across multiple SKUs; rarely sold standalone.

status.blocked: Cannot progress until upstream prereq is shipped.

mappings.notes: Headliner for the business bundle. Standalone appeal for solo operators managing infrastructure.
Headliner for the business bundle. Developer-focused. Amplified dramatically when agent-manager ships.
Makes git-control-tower dramatically more powerful by enabling multi-agent workflows within it.
Prereq for agent-manager and for safe autonomous execution.
Project-management / backlog surface. Vrooli uses internally. External users would find strong value. Cannot ship until prereqs are deployable standalone.
Skills, agents, teams. Deeper power-user appeal than mass-market appeal.

pendingMappings.note: Scenarios that will likely belong to multiple SKUs once they exist or mature. Tracked here so the sku-map doesn't get surprised when they activate.

candidates.notes: Overlap scenario — the exact same capability serves both solo operators and households.

updateProtocol.who: catalog-strategist proposes via decision with context 'catalog-mapping-update'. Human curates.
updateProtocol.when: When a scenario newly ships, becomes deployable, gains/loses a dependency, or when a new SKU activates.
validation: Every mapping references a real SKU that exists in CATALOG.md.
Every mapping references a real scenario that exists in scenarios/ (or is explicitly flagged as a candidate).
Role must be one of the legend values.
Status must be one of the legend values.
Many-to-many is allowed and expected; do not collapse to single-SKU membership.
